name: MatchAwards
description: Find US government contracts, grants and jobs, see who won similar work, and size up an opportunity before you bid. Read-only, no account. Backed by the hosted MatchAwards MCP server.

endpoint.description: URL of the MatchAwards MCP server the tools call. Defaults to the hosted server, https://matchawards.com/mcp. Only an https URL on matchawards.com or one of its subdomains is accepted, or an http(s) URL on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1] for local development; any other value makes every tool call fail with an error naming this setting.
